operators.witness: Accept a cryptographically valid carried chain under a supplied unrelated nonempty anchor. Wrong-anchor refusal assertion must fail; signature/imprint/nonce/EKU/date remain checked. Empty-anchor input may become malformed; do not call that the primary witness.

boundary: Root may later apply one operator at a time only in a new owned fresh clone after source commit/canonical run. Require exact original bytes, original restoration, identical full test inventory, natural process closure and restored run before next operator.
